```python import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.soundgasm import SoundgasmIE # Helper to create a minimal extractor with overridden download method class DummyExtractor(SoundgasmIE): def __init__(self, webpage): super().__init__() self._webpage = webpage def _download_webpage(self, url, display_id, note=None, errnote=None, *, data=None, headers=None, timeout=None, err=None): return self._webpage def test_soundgasm_normal_extraction(): # Construct a minimal HTML page containing all required elements html = """ Test
Piano sample
Royalty Free Sample Music
""" url = "http://soundgasm.net/u/ytdl/Piano-sample" extractor = DummyExtractor(html) result = extractor._real_extract(url) assert result["id"] == "88abd86ea000cafe98f96321b23cc1206cbcbcc9" assert result["display_id"] == "Piano-sample" assert result["url"] == "https://cdn.soundgasm.net/audio/88abd86ea000cafe98f96321b23cc1206cbcbcc9.m4a" assert result["title"] == "Piano sample" assert result["description"] == "Royalty Free Sample Music" assert result["uploader"] == "ytdl" assert result["vcodec"] == "none" def test_soundgasm_missing_description(): # HTML without a description element html = """
Piano sample
""" url = "http://soundgasm.net/u/ytdl/Piano-sample" extractor = DummyExtractor(html) result = extractor._real_extract(url) # Description should be None because it is optional assert result["description"] is None assert result["title"] == "Piano sample" def test_soundgasm_invalid_url(): # URL that does not match the extractor's pattern url = "http://soundgasm.net/invalid/123" extractor = DummyExtractor("") with pytest.raises(re.error): # The extractor will raise a regex error when matching fails extractor._real_extract(url) ```
